Hey, it's a [[Jawa]]! This [[Jawa]], however, provides a few extra benefits when compared to his Premiere counterpart. Reducing Force drains and having an additional one added to power makes these little characters useful. Mix these with some unique Jawas and you have a crazy deck that might just work.
